method.status: effective fitted parameter of the rendered asset as seen by the detector; NOT an anatomical dimension
method.model: detected = project(eye_centre + q_gaze @ (axis * d)) + constant offset (dx, dy) per eye and condition; unrefracted pinhole projection
method.heldout_set: 14 poses never used for fitting: r=0.5 ring at half-step angles (k=0..9) + diagonals (+-0.7, +-0.7)
method.selection: d* = argmin over the depth grid of the combined x/y residual RMSE of the fit set, offset re-fitted at every d
method.bootstrap: non-parametric percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng seed 12345; sampling unit = fit pose (one eye's detected pupil at one gaze, its x and y kept paired), drawn with replacement from that eye's usable fit poses; offset and d* re-fitted per resample; interval = 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of d* (grid-quantised to the 0.05 mm step); eyes fitted separately
method.sensitivity: leave-one-pose-out d* for every fit pose; left and right eyes at the same gaze share rendering/lighting so they are reported separately, never pooled
method.heldout_separation: held-out poses (ids 20..33) enter neither the depth selection, the offset, nor the bootstrap; they are only predicted
method.exclusion: detections with status 'fail' or more than 8 px from the wrapper point are excluded and listed
method.cornea_note: the rendered 'Lens' material is Transparent+Glossy (no refraction); the projection here is unrefracted, while the official pupil_center_2D includes analytic corneal refraction (0.45-0.58 px)
